Name: Combat Gear Enhanced
Author: vnmryan
Description:
A simple mod boosting the stats of the top tier combat gear. The galaxy sword attack is bumped from 60-80 to 70-90, and the space boots are bumped from +4 defense/immunity to +8.

If you already own these items, you will need to reacquire them using an item spawner. Stardew Valley stores the stats of items in your save file, they will need to be regenerated.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
